meta.title: Surface Current Density Converter — Convert Ampere/m² and More
meta.description: Free surface current density converter for 3+ units including Ampere/m², Ampere/cm², Ampere/in². Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: A/m², A/cm², A/in². Convert between 3 surface current density units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for surface current density in this tool is **Am2**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most surface current density conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.

content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
